english_source: Modeled usable capacity is 80% for LFP (20-100%), 85% for sodium-ion (15-100%), and 50% for lead-acid (50-100%). In this model, LFP and sodium-ion need fewer replacements than lead-acid over 20 years. Standard LFP voltage settings cap sodium-ion at about 85% of rated capacity; its shallower discharge supports longer cycle life. Lead-acid is limited to its upper half and is derated under heavy discharge. Weather dips from {startYear} to {endYear} show when grid or generator power would be needed.
current_translation: A capacidade utilizável modelada é 80% para LFP (20-100%), 85% para íons de sódio (15-100%) e 50% para chumbo-ácido (50-100%). As tensões padrão de LFP limitam os íons de sódio a cerca de 85% da capacidade nominal; a descarga menos profunda favorece uma vida útil maior em ciclos. Chumbo-ácido fica limitado à metade superior e perde capacidade útil sob descarga intensa. As quedas no clima observado de {startYear} a {endYear} mostram quando seria necessária energia da rede ou do gerador.
